COM.note: The document says nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: Al-watwan reports that AI in the Comoros is limited so far to personal uses, with no national AI policy yet, according to an Anaden official.

COM.note: No AI tool in a public sector system is stated; agriculture and health uses are only possibilities.

facts.fact: An Anaden official told Al-watwan there is no national AI policy, 'but we are thinking about it'; the digital strategy Comores Numerique 2028 only tracks reflections on future technology including AI.

COM.note: Only modest student projects at the IUT are named; no model, dataset or AI computing is stated as built or in service.
